Behind the link radar of September 8, 2026

The validation run for the new curation format produced a dated radar post with five primary-source links, each checked for success before publication, plus this entry logging the trail the same day. Reviewers approved the exact pull-request head before merge, and the merge carried the radar post and this entry to the front page.

The curation routine needed one manual validation run before going live on schedule. This entry logs the validation run that shipped the first radar post in the fixed curation pattern.

Motivation

The build log shows how each visible change shipped. This entry covers the validation run for the daily curation format: one dated radar post with the most significant builder-relevant reads of the window, each linked to a source that returned success when checked. The live radar is the link radar of that day.

What changed

The run produced five reads: an inside view of research acceleration with internal coding-agent numbers; the chief scientist essay on alien minds and fading oversight; a sixteen-organization climate accelerator across Asia-Pacific; a multi-model orchestration preview for code assistants; and a checklist for reviewing the combined output of parallel coding agents. All five addresses returned success when checked, with no overlap against recent digests.

How it was done

The radar shipped through the pull request at the reviewed head, with security and quality sign-off on the same head, then merged to the main branch. The pick list came from the editor record with each address verified before drafting. The live site synced and the radar page, sitemap, feed and robots verified at success status.

Verification evidence

Security and quality sign-off on the reviewed head; merged main with five verified reads. Every source link returned success when checked before publication, and the deterministic site build plus the full test suite passed. HTTP logs and full review text are not evidenced in the linked record.

Built strictly from the linked review record; each step ran through the company pipeline.

Director
